# Data

## Import Data

```{r Import Data}
clean_data <-read_csv("data/processed/clean_CTQ_SEM_data.csv")

```


# Analysis

## Original and Alternative Models 

The original model(Bernstein et al., 2003) has five items for each dimension. 

```{r create original model}

original_model <- 'sexabuse  =~ SA1sextouch + SA2sexthreat + SA3sexdowatch + SA4molest + SA5sexabuse
                      emotabuse =~ EA1calledthings + EA2wasntborn + EA3insults + EA4felthated + EA5emotabuse
                      physicalabuse =~ PA1hitdoctor + PA2bruises + PA3hitobject + PA4phyabused + PA5hitnoticed
                      physicalneg =~ PN1eat + PN2careprotect+ PN3drunkhigh + PN4dirtyclothes + PN5doctor    
                      emotneg =~ EN1specimp + EN2loved + EN3helpfulfam + EN4closefam + EN5famsup'

```

The alternative model(Gerdner & Allgulander,2009) shifts two items from physical to emotional neglect.

```{r create alternative model}


alternative_model <- 'sexabuse  =~  SA1sextouch + SA2sexthreat + SA3sexdowatch + SA4molest + SA5sexabuse
                    emotabuse =~ EA1calledthings + EA2wasntborn + EA3insults + EA4felthated + EA5emotabuse
                    physicalabuse =~ PA1hitdoctor + PA2bruises + PA3hitobject + PA4phyabused + PA5hitnoticed 
                    emotneg =~ EN1specimp + EN2loved + EN3helpfulfam + EN4closefam + EN5famsup + PN2careprotect + PN5doctor
                    physicalneg =~ PN1eat + PN3drunkhigh + PN4dirtyclothes'


```

## Multi-Group Confirmatory Factor Analysis (MGCFA)

### MGCFA - Original Model

#### Step 1: Test the Whole Model

Question: Does the factor structure/measurement model work?

```{r unrestricted-original model-entire sample}

overall_original_fit <- cfa (model = original_model, 
     data = clean_data, 
# set meanstructure = T so that all models are the same
     meanstructure = T,
     ordered = T)

summary (overall_original_fit, standardized = T, fit.measure = T)

```

Do they work within each group?

```{r unrestricted-original model-White}

white_original_fit <- cfa (model = original_model, 
     data = CFA_data[CFA_data$Race == "White", ], 
     meanstructure = T,
     ordered = T)

summary (white_original_fit, standardized = T, fit.measure = T)

```


```{r unrestricted-original model-Black}

black_original_fit <- cfa (model = original_model, 
     data = CFA_data[CFA_data$Race == "Black", ], 
     meanstructure = T,
     ordered = T)

summary (black_original_fit, standardized = T, fit.measure = T)

```


#### Step 2: Test for Configural Invariance

Does the factor structure work the same across groups?


```{r unrestricted-layer two separate models}

configural_original_fit <- cfa (model = original_model, 
     data = clean_data, 
     meanstructure = T, 
     group = "Race",
     ordered = T)

summary (configural_original_fit, standardized = T, fit.measure = T)

```


#### Step 3: Test for Metric Invariance


Are the factor loadings the same? In order words, do the individual items group together in the same way across groups.


```{r Restrict loadings/estimates}

metric_original_fit <- cfa (model = original_model, 
     data = clean_data, 
     meanstructure = T,
     ordered = T,
     group = "Race", 
     group.equal = c("loadings"))

summary(metric_original_fit, standardized = T, fit.measure = T)

```

#### Step 4: Test for Scalar Invariance

Are the item intercepts the same? In other words, are the means of the latent variables the same across groups?


```{r restrict the intercepts}

scalar_original_fit <- cfa (model = original_model, 
     data = clean_data, 
     meanstructure = T, 
     ordered = T,
     group = "Race", 
     group.equal = c("loadings", "intercepts"))

summary(scalar_original_fit, standardized = T, fit.measure = T)

```

#### Step 5: Test for Strict/Error Invariance

are the item residuals the same? In other words, are the confidence intervals similar?


```{r restrict the error variances}

strict_original_fit <- cfa (model = original_model, 
     data = clean_data, 
     meanstructure = T, 
     ordered = T,
     group = "Race", 
     group.equal = c("loadings", "intercepts", "residuals"))

summary(strict_original_fit, standardized = T, fit.measure = T)

```

#### Step 6: Create the Output

Tips for creating this table came from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kt2lZxcAGWs&list=PLVtFgtzwI3cp2PcxxtEvh0wQ91IU2UwJm&index=3 

```{r Create Table for Original Model}

table_fit_original <- matrix(NA, nrow = 9, ncol = 5)
colnames(table_fit_original) = c("Model", "X2", "df", "CFI", "RMSEA")
table_fit_original[1, ] <- c ("Overall Original", round (fitmeasures(overall_original_fit, 
                                            c("chisq", "df", "cfi", "rmsea")), 3))

table_fit_original[2, ] <- c ("White Original", round (fitmeasures(white_original_fit, 
                                             c("chisq", "df", "cfi", "rmsea")), 3))

table_fit_original[3, ] <- c ("Black Original", round (fitmeasures(black_original_fit, 
                                             c("chisq", "df", "cfi", "rmsea")), 3))

table_fit_original[4, ] <- c ("Config Original", round (fitmeasures(configural_original_fit, 
                                             c("chisq", "df", "cfi", "rmsea")), 3))


table_fit_original[5, ] <- c ("Metric Original", round (fitmeasures(metric_original_fit, 
                                           c("chisq", "df", "cfi", "rmsea")), 3))


table_fit_original[6, ] <- c ("Scalar Original", round (fitmeasures(scalar_original_fit, 
                                            c("chisq", "df", "cfi", "rmsea")), 3))


table_fit_original[7, ] <- c ("Strict Original", round (fitmeasures(strict_original_fit, 
                                            c("chisq", "df", "cfi", "rmsea")), 3))
                                            
kable (table_fit_original)

```



### MGCFA - Alternative Model

#### Step 1: Test the Whole Model

Question: Does the factor structure/measurement model work?

```{r}

overall_alternative_fit <- cfa (model = AlternativeModel, 
     data = clean_data, 
     meanstructure = T,
     ordered = T)

summary (overall_alternative_fit, standardized = T, fit.measure = T)

```


Check for White participants

```{r}

white_alternative_fit <- cfa (model = AlternativeModel, 
     data = CFA_data[CFA_data$Race == "White", ], 
     meanstructure = T,
     ordered = T)

summary (white_alternative_fit, standardized = T, fit.measure = T)

```


Check for Black participants

```{r}

black_alternative_fit <- cfa (model = AlternativeModel, 
     data = CFA_data[CFA_data$Race == "Black", ], 
     meanstructure = T,
     ordered = T)

summary (black_alternative_fit, standardized = T, fit.measure = T)

```

#### Step 4: Test for Scalar Invariance

#### Step 5: Test for Strict/Error Invariance

are the item residuals the same? In other words, are the confidence intervals similar?

```{r}

```

```{r Alternative Model Fit Indices Table}
colnames(table_fit_alternative) = c("Model", "X2", "df", "CFI", "RMSEA")

                                             c("chisq", "df", "cfi", "rmsea")), 3))

                                             c("chisq", "df", "cfi", "rmsea")), 3))


table_fit_alternative[5, ] <- c ("Metric Alternative", round (fitmeasures(metric_alternative_fit, 
                                           c("chisq", "df", "cfi", "rmsea")), 3))


table_fit_alternative[6, ] <- c ("Scalar Alternative", round (fitmeasures(scalar_alternative_fit, 
                                            c("chisq", "df", "cfi", "rmsea")), 3))


table_fit_alternative[7, ] <- c ("Strict Alternative", round (fitmeasures(strict_alternative_fit, 
                                            c("chisq", "df", "cfi", "rmsea")), 3))
                                            
kable (table_fit_alternative)

```
